name: kxtrumpact
title: How many presidential actions will Trump take this week? (10/11-10/17)
settlement: The market resolves based on the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 18, 2026. If Trump has taken at least N presidential actions (proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, memoranda) with publication dates from Oct 11-17, 2026, the market resolves Yes for that strike.
decideContext: Estimate the effect of news on the count of presidential actions (executive orders, proclamations, memoranda, nominations/appointments) published on whitehouse.gov's Presidential Actions page during Oct 11-17, 2026; market resolves Yes at each threshold if the count meets or exceeds it as checked Oct 18 10AM ET.
